name: Haolong
sum: A hadrosauroid of the Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation of Liaoning, China, with spine-like skin structures preserved on a nearly complete skeleton.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: A nearly complete skeleton with preserved integument from the Yixian Formation, Liaoning.
exceptional: Cellular-level preservation of cutaneous spikes (Huang et al. 2026).
biology: The name means "spiny dragon", after its skin spikes.
author: Huang et al. 2026

sources.text: Huang, J.; Wu, W.; Mao, L.; Bertozzo, F.; Dhouailly, D.; Robin, N.; Pittman, M.; Kaye, T. G.; Manucci, F.; He, X.; Wang, X.; Godefroit, P. 2026.
